scope: Deterministic helper source and trust-boundary review. No card-fact re-review, model calls, publication, production writes, credential access, Git changes or implementation edits.

findings.title: Bind the reused prior release bundle to its published receipt
findings.details: prepare checks after-deck.json against receipt.sha256 but never checks release-bundle.json against the receipt's existing bundleSha256 or checks its releaseId against receipt.releaseId. A modified prior review prompt/corpus/evidence binding can therefore be reused as verified prior evidence.

probe.change: In a temporary copy, replace prior review.promptHash with64zeroes while leaving publication-verification.json unchanged.
probe.backend: Only backend_hashes was mocked using the existing real-replay hashes. Current review/model-response/render/source binding functions ran unchanged.

findings.requestedFix: Require exact prior bundle SHA and release identity from the verified publication receipt before reusing any prior review evidence; add a tamper regression.

findings.title: Bind baseline verification to the prepared release and deck
findings.details: verify_baseline loads expected-baseline.json and current backup metadata but never validates the prepared release-bundle/preflight identity. It ignores backup deckId/deck.id/deck.slug and emits PASS without releaseId, bundle SHA or backup SHA. The existing test passes with no prepared release bundle at all.
findings.requestedFix: Require the valid prepared-bundle/preflight identity and expected deck ID/slug, then include releaseId, bundle SHA, backup SHA and editingSnapshot in the baseline verification receipt.

confirmedBehavior: Frozen model input/output/request/schema files are hashed against execution receipts; the recorded completed response must decode to the actual structured output.
Rendered import must exactly equal frozen candidate semantics and metadata.
Targeted review covers exactly failed cards; any changed original transfer card is rejected from old transfer reuse.
Unselected baseline bodies/revisions and server card hashes are compared against prior data.
The helper contains no model invocation or publication action; its generated artifacts explicitly record noProductionWrite.
Output directory creation uses mkdir without exist_ok, refusing an existing output directory.
limits: Actual PostgreSQL16/.NET hash reproduction is being checked independently.
Root is applying targeted fixes; final review is pending.
